coachMessages.text: When Red plays on an even row, Yellow can 'claim' the cell directly above. Red gets row 0 (even), Yellow gets row 1 (odd).

slides.infoProse: Red plays column 3 landing on row 0 (an even row). Yellow responds by playing directly above at row 1. The claimeven response ensures Yellow controls the odd row in this column.

coachMessages.text: Yellow's claimeven strategy: always respond above Red's even-row move. Yellow controls every odd row that Red reaches on an even row.

slides.infoProse: After several claimeven responses across the board, Yellow controls the odd row in every column where Red played on an even row. This builds Yellow's positional advantage.
